reasoning_content:
Now let me set up the environment. First create the .env in deployment. I'll try the dev compose approach first as it's designed for local. Let me create the .env file based on the dev README section.

Note the frontend Dockerfile uses ARG PUBLIC_DOCUMENTATION_URL but docker-compose.dev.yml build args don't include it. That's fine.

Let me create .env. Also note that the backend Dockerfile downloads docker CLI from download.docker.com - network needed. And pip install of geopandas etc needs PyPI.

Let me generate secret keys. I don't have python locally. I can use openssl or just craft values. DJANGO_SECRET_KEY needs to be a string, no special format. FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY needs to be a Fernet key (base64 32 bytes). I can generate with openssl: `openssl rand -base64 32`. Let me check openssl availability.

Let me create the .env.

action.command: which openssl && openssl rand -base64 32 && echo "---" && openssl rand -base64 48 | tr -d '\n' && echo

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "which openssl && openssl rand -base64 32 && echo \"---\" && openssl rand -base64 48 | tr -d '\\n' && echo", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Generate secret keys with openssl"}
